Subject: ENGAGE STACK webinar — priority-seed lists, routing & tracking tokens

Team —

Quick planning note before I reach out to Acme: we want to offer them a "Priority Access" wave (small cohort RSVP + 15-minute pre-demo slot) as part of the inbound webinar. High-level asks: 

- Ben: can you produce two seed lists (architects + platform leads) of ~120 each from the field repo by COB Wed? Please annotate source (partner-sourced vs inbound).
- Marissa: I'll need three subject/preview variants and the tracking token map. Can you include a CTA that surfaces the pre-demo slot (calendar link)? I attached a working sheet for copy variants.

Routing note: we'll route Acme traffic to dedicated high-touch webhook for signups (so we can capture org metadata and flag SRs). Ben, confirm the routing label "acme-priority" exists in the tracking layer, otherwise we'll create a fallback tag.

I'll loop in Acme once the seed lists are set. Keep this tight — they asked for an explicit slot for their platform team.

Thanks,
Priyom

Hi Lydia —

Thanks again for the interest. Quick note on what we can offer for Acme: a Priority Access wave (limited RSVP list, RSVP auto-qualification for a 15-minute private pre-demo slot with a solutions architect). We can also enable a partner-handshake that routes your signups to your events ops (EventPartner) for local logistics.

Proposed timeline:
- Wed Jul 17: seed list drop (we'll send the first batch of 120 invites)
- Mon Jul 22: second wave and broad invite to remaining inbound segment
- Webinar: Tue Jul 30 at 11am PT

Tracking & integration: we'll append a tracking token param (tk=acme-prio-2028) to RSVP links and push webhook payloads to the partner endpoint you shared. We will also flag HubSpot deal DEAL-ACM-4821 when someone claims a pre-demo slot.

I'm copying Ben & Marissa to coordinate copy + seed lists. Anything you want prioritized (regions, product threads, or prefer English only)?

Best,
Priyom
Senior Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
